Exact files from the ASTRA public-edition build (base commit b7b86361d20c284ad0ff81aeacf46cd8392fc168 plus SOURCE_CHANGES_on_b7b86361_incl_public_edition.patch, sha256 49af02fd40b72fcc5713fe1f3c2d24b45114cae9e2c586aca93f15af35aee025). openIssues: Model valuation spread of -39.3% (fair value INR 420.32 against a price of INR 692.80). Reliability is LOW.
Asset quality and capital adequacy are not evaluated (3 of 26 rubric criteria scored).
The second data source (Yahoo) differs from the NSE lender XBRL by 40 to 53% on revenue and owners' equity (7 field-years over 25%).
No segment data and no peer multiples.

DCF cash flows come from the canonical forecast, not the withheld linked three-statement package.
No telecom operating drivers (ARPU, subscribers, spectrum) in the output. Peer comparison uses only 2 peers, with low weight given to them.

openIssues: The model's confidence gate fails: the model valuation spread of -61.1% (fair value INR 364.92 against a price of INR 939.10) is beyond the 60% limit, so the report states no assessment. The figures are still displayed in the PDF and Excel file. Run status is FAILED (LF_NO_PLUG, worst difference 14.68 Cr).

Historical EPS is withheld (shown as n/a): the statement share count of 61.8 Cr is 10.06 times below the 622 Cr used in the valuation, pending the exchange split and bonus record. The raw 61.8 Cr count still appears in the statement rows.
The fee-income driver prints as 0.0040% of AUM, likely a unit error. Not fixed.
